title: Weekly facts
description: Computed by code once per evaluation week and passed to the weekly-decision, weekly-report, block-review and phase-review skills. The model never recalculates these numbers. All weights in kg, energy in kcal, dates ISO 8601 (Europe/Vienna).

phase_id.description: Active phase skill id, e.g. reverse_bulk.

in_glycogen_window.description: True while phase_week is inside the phase's glycogen_window_weeks.

phase_first_change_pending.description: True until the phase's first change (e.g. the week-1 increase) has been applied. The max-change guardrail does not apply to that change.

food_log_complete.description: All days logged and no day flagged as partially logged.

last_sync_at.description: Older of the MFP and Hevy last successful syncs; null until both have synced.

code_usable.description: Mechanical check only (weigh-ins, logs, sync). The skill additionally reads context notes.

band.description: Target rate band for this phase week (kg/week, signed) plus optional hard limits outside it.

vs_band.description: Numeric position of weekly_rate_kg relative to band. not_evaluated inside the glycogen window or when the week is not code_usable.

predicted_avg_7d_kg.description: Code's prediction for this week, made at the start of the week: prev_avg_7d_kg + the surplus in force then x 7 / maintenance_estimate.kcal_per_kg (the targets assume the maintenance estimate).

prediction_miss.description: |prediction_error_kg| > decisions.prediction_miss_kg. False when either value is null.

adherence_ok.description: All eating logged AND |deviation_pct| within the adherence tolerance.

macro_targets.description: Average daily macro targets. Carbs are the remainder and vary per day with the calorie target.

fiber_target_g.description: [min, max] grams/day from fiber_g_per_kg x reference weight.

sport_load_high.description: A context note tagged sport_load applies to a day of this week. Such a week is skipped for confirmation and gives no C/D call.

tracked_lifts.description: Every exercise logged in Hevy trained since the phase start or within lift_recency_days, counting ones first.

counted_lifts.description: Counting lifts (not excluded) whose status is improved, same or declined.

share_improved.description: improved_lifts / counted_lifts; null if no lift could be counted.

progression_met.description: improved_lifts >= progression_min_share x counted_lifts (one exercise, one vote). null if no lift could be counted.

stalls.description: Counting exercise_ids whose no_progress_streak reached stall_sessions (excluded exercises get no stall flags).

declining_lifts.description: Counting exercise_ids that declined decline_sessions_for_deload sessions in a row.

excluded_lifts.description: Listed exercises classified as excluded (prehab/rehab, slow movers): no effect on A–E, PRs still named.

deload_signal.description: At least deload_min_lifts_declining lifts declined for decline_sessions_for_deload sessions in a row.

prs.description: PRs set this week (best session since the lift's baseline).

targets.description: Daily target = base_at_step_goal_kcal + step kcal (k x (day steps - step_goal)) + that day's counted sessions + surplus_kcal; on an average-steps day that is base_maintenance_kcal + sessions + surplus_kcal. surplus_kcal can be negative (e.g. early reverse, cut).

base_maintenance_kcal.description: Maintenance without counted sessions, at the average day steps.

excluded_weeks.description: Glycogen or unusable weeks left out of the calculation.

step_goal.description: Steps where step kcal are 0 (setup value, default steps.step_goal).

avg_day_steps.description: Average day steps (run steps removed, untracked days left out) over the maintenance window; base_maintenance_kcal is at these steps.

step_kcal_per_1000_steps.description: k x 1000: what 1,000 day steps above or below the goal add to or take off a day's target.

base_at_step_goal_kcal.description: base_maintenance_kcal - k x (avg_day_steps - step_goal): the base shown at the step goal. Daily target = this + k x (day steps - step_goal) + counted sessions + surplus_kcal. Null: no step model (no step adjustment).

mfp_goal_kcal.description: Calorie goal currently set in MyFitnessPal: base_maintenance_kcal + surplus_kcal (a rest day; activity comes on top, added mentally in MFP).

weeks_since_last_change.description: Weeks since the last applied calorie change that count for confirmation, this week included (counted as 1).

previous_verdicts.description: Most recent verdicts, newest first (up to 6), including skipped weeks.

skip_reason.description: Why code skipped the week for confirmation (neither counts nor breaks a streak).

confirmation_streaks.description: Consecutive earlier weeks (this week not included) pointing to an increase / a decrease since the last change, skipped weeks left out. Add this week if it points the same way.

params.description: Merged core + phase parameters (phase wins on equal keys), exactly as code used them. Skills refer to these by name.

produce_g.description: Fruit + vegetables, if derivable from the food log; null otherwise.

kcal_counted.description: Activity kcal added to that day's target: Strava run kcal x run discount, lifting kcal per Hevy session, wrestling kcal per planned session, reported kcal for extras: the user's, code-estimated or model-estimated (runs discounted). 0 when skipped.

status.description: done: synced (Strava, Hevy) or reported by the user. planned: wrestling counted as planned, no report. skipped: a planned session the user reported skipped (counts 0). Optional or unsynced sessions that did not happen are not listed.

bodyweight_exercise.description: Dips, pull-ups etc.: effective load includes bodyweight.

counts.description: Counts for progression (not classified as excluded).

classification.description: The model's classification, flippable by the user in chat: counts (compounds, machines, most bigger isolation work) or excluded (prehab/rehab, slow movers such as lateral raises, abs, plyometrics). null = not classified yet, counts.

counted.description: Counts for progression_met this week: a counting lift judged improved / same / declined.

last_session_date.description: Its latest session that wasn't ignored (other_location, no working set).

lift_status.description: improved/same/declined: the session's heaviest working set (rep_range) vs the best of the previous compare_best_of_last_sessions sessions. new_baseline: the first session of the exercise or after a baseline reset (starts its history, no PR). not_judged: see not_judged_reason. paused: injury pause. stale: not trained within lift_recency_days.

not_judged_reason.description: Why a session wasn't judged: first_session / baseline_reset (new_baseline), after_break (first session after more than lift_recency_days), building_baseline (fewer than min_sessions_for_compare sessions), other_location (a context note says another gym or machine that day: no baseline, PR or reset question), no_working_sets (no non-warm-up set in rep_range).

load_kg.description: As logged in Hevy (added or assisting load for bodyweight exercises).

effective_load_kg.description: load_kg; for bodyweight exercises the bodyweight plus added load (minus assistance).
